audit.why: Difficulty framing (7/10, Tricky, poke lane, artillery-position R) matches Xerath's real kit — long-range Q/W poke and a channel R that punishes Bard's short engage range.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns has no digit (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT) — it calls Shocking Orb 'matchup-defining' but never states the actual cooldown.
audit.why: The audit brief requires real cooldown numbers; Shocking Orb (E) is 13/12.5/12/11.5/11s by rank, which is the number a player needs to know when to step up.
audit.corrected: Inserted the 13-11s rank cooldown into breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing on the page states that Xerath's R (Rite of the Arcane) is a channel that any CC cancels — missingInteractions flagged this as applicable and absent.
audit.why: Bard's Q (Cosmic Binding) is a stun/slow projectile; landing it on a channeling Xerath cancels Rite of the Arcane outright, which is a much stronger counter-play than merely dodging the individual snipes the page currently emphasizes.
audit.corrected: Rewrote dosFull[1] (previously a copy-pasted tradeGood bleed) to state the channel-cancel interaction directly.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level-chart rows disagree between layers: full phases[0].side says 'Xerath' while content win[0] says 'Skill' (even), and full phases[1]-[5].side all say 'Skill' while content win[1]-win[5] all say 'Xerath' — the opposite of what the packet levelChart and the content whys[] actually argue.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is ['Skill','Xerath','Xerath','Xerath','Xerath','Xerath','Skill'] and content.whys[0-5] already explain Xerath's Q+W outranging Meep poke from level 2, E-stun-into-Q burst at 3-5, artillery range at 4-5, R snipes at 6, and mana-burst Q at first item — all consistent with content win[]. The full layer's side column was simply wrong on 6 of 7 rows.
audit.corrected: Flipped phases[0].side to Skill and phases[1-5].side to Xerath to match win[]/packet, rewriting each .why to state the same verdict (win[] itself needed no edit since it already matched the target).

edits.before: Meep-chip the contacts and collect the first chimes — the wanderer's ledger opens.
edits.after: No combo online yet — a clean wall-stun bump beats his poke as often as it loses.

edits.before: Q threats begin: every wall adjacency is a stun audition.
edits.after: Q plus W out-range Meep poke; he chips free outside stun range.

edits.before: Full kit: shrine the sustain, tunnel the angles, and Q the geometry.
edits.after: Shocking Orb stun guarantees a free Q burst you can't answer at range.

edits.before: Chime economy: collect on the move and return with meep upgrades — absence is investment.
edits.after: His artillery range keeps you chipped and out of engage range through mid-lane.

edits.before: Tempered Fate online — the map's biggest moments now have a stasis clause.
edits.after: His three long-range R snipes now out-pressure your single-target stasis ult.

edits.before: First item: the meeps chunk and the portals make your jungler ambidextrous.
edits.after: First-item mana burst makes his Q poke lethal while you bleed mana healing.

edits.before: - Xerath Shocking Orb (Stun): matchup-defining — His only CC — dodge the orb and the artillery never converts. It writes your spacing rules. - E Magical Journey is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.
edits.after: - Xerath Shocking Orb (Stun): 13-11s cooldown by rank — dodge it and the artillery never converts. It writes your spacing rules. - E Magical Journey is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.

edits.before: Bait the answer, start the chain, and let your carry collect — engage trades are all-or-nothing; pick the all.
edits.after: His Rite of the Arcane channel breaks on any stun — land Cosmic Binding on him and the ultimate cancels outright.

edits.before: Engaging into a banked disengage — the chain that starts answered is a donation with intentions.
edits.after: Popping the shrine at full HP wastes it — save the heal for when Xerath's poke has chipped your team.
